content: First, we evaluate our model in the context of MT, as the translation quality can be expected to have influence on the other tasks that the model performs. We use public benchmarks for Estonian-English and Latvian-English translations from the news translation shared tasks of WMT 2017 and 2018 BIBREF18 , BIBREF19 . The BLEU scores for each translation direction and all included styles/domains are shown in Table TABREF6 .
